title: The Best Way to Cook Shrimp
summary: This ATK Techniquely episode presents a masterclass on cooking shrimp with attention to texture, moisture, and browning. The host contrasts frozen vs. fresh shrimp, explains how salting and moisture management affect tenderness, and demonstrates a cold-start, high-heat sear to achieve even browning without overcooking. It then blends in flavor-building steps: a quick toast of a spice mix, a finish with lime and cilantro, and practical variations such as sous-vide poaching and a brined shrimp cocktail approach with accompanying sauce ideas. Throughout, the emphasis is on controlling moisture, heat, and timing to keep shrimp tender, juicy, and flavorful rather than dry or rubbery.
